contract_assessment.future_correction: If a future contract requires every selected prompt in full, explicitly version a custom preprocessor/JOIN change retaining the 1881-token tail: 30 batches, same 256 IDs, no new data. The installed GPTQ data-only preparation accepts 29 x 2048 + 1881 with batch_size 1 and no padding. Such a policy changes the quantization input and requires new GPTQ weights plus repeated activation calibration and evaluation before qualification. Also capture runtime token hashes.
